title: A Prince Gives Away His Robe
story: David and Jonathan Are Best Friends
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Prince Jonathan saw David brave
And loved him right away.
They laughed and talked and walked as friends,
Best friends from that first day.

[Chorus]
A real friend shares and cheers you on
And smiles when things go right.
A friend like that is God's own gift,
So hold that friendship tight.

[Verse 2]
He gave his robe, his sword, his bow,
A prince's gifts, so grand.
And when God blessed his friend so much,
He cheered and took his hand.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, my little friend,
The day is tucked away.
Be glad for others, share your best,
And God is near to stay.

[Chorus]
mood: Strolling music. An easy, ambling sway rocks under the voice like two friends walking side by side, light and unhurried, with a little bounce on the chorus where the friendship shines. It matches the story's warmth and open hands. By the last verse the stroll slows to a gentle rock, lower and softer, settling in like a hand resting on a shoulder at bedtime.
